comment: Simplified ACU MSRR primary loop based on primary_loop.json and PSAR Revision 2 (July 2024), Chapter 4. SI units. Coupled point kinetics with 10 MW initial power and prescribed HX wall temperature; steady and transient states.

sources: Chapter 4, Sections 4.1 and 4.6.1.2 describe vessel -> RAV -> pump -> shell-side HX -> vessel. This simplified model omits the RAV and connects the vessel hot riser directly to the pump.
Table 4.1-1 (printed p. 4-5 / PDF p. 260): 1 MW thermal power; 650 C maximum operating temperature.
Table 4.2-1 (printed p. 4-20 / PDF p. 275): fuel-channel diameter 0.03016 m, core height 1.5168 m, graphite lattice pitch 0.1016 m, outer lattice radius 0.65 m.
Section 4.2.1.1 (printed p. 4-6): about 0.4 m3 fuel salt in vessel and 0.5 m3 in operating loop; drain-tank inventory excluded.
Section 4.5.4.4 (printed p. 4-43): baseline average vessel temperature 873.15 K and vessel pressure 150000 Pa. These are reference conditions, not imposed temperature or flow constraints.
geometry_assumptions: 148 explicit fuel channels in a hex_core at 0.1016 m nearest-neighbor pitch. A 151-site triangular-lattice footprint is clipped to the 0.65 m lattice radius allowing for channel radius, then three interior sites are omitted in a threefold pattern to obtain 148 channels. This is an assumed channel map, not a PSAR-specified channel count or exact control-rod layout; bypass flow remains unresolved.

Core liquid volume 0.160377186788 m3. Each equivalent plenum holds 0.119811406606 m3, giving 0.4 m3 total vessel salt. Plenum length 0.2 m and equivalent radii are modeling choices. The finite plenums remain separate loop components. The hex_core internal plenums, manifolds and coupling nozzles have negligible length and inventory.
Connecting pipe ID 0.05898 m is an approximate bore for the nominal 2.5-inch Schedule 80 piping described in Section 4.1.1; nominal pipe size is not used as bore.

Pipe routing, riser height and pump liquid volume 0.005 m3 are assumptions. The RAV is omitted; the hot riser is extended from 0.8 m to 1.1 m to replace its 0.3 m height and retain the pump elevation. The 3.0168 m cold downcomer and 2.55829 m cold return close the loop in elevation and plan within roundoff. Figure 4.1-3 is not a dimensioned piping drawing.

HX length 1.8288 m inherited from primary_loop.json. Shell holdup remains 0.0456700208068 m3 and effective heated area 30 m2 remains an assumed surrogate, not a Chapter 4 specification. Total loop salt inventory is approximately 0.47082 m3 (471 L) after removing the RAV; the approximate PSAR 500 L inventory is not imposed.

Auto nozzles provide internal area transitions with negligible added inventory. An explicit negligible-length nozzle closes the last pipe into the lower plenum because automatic transitions do not handle the last-to-first connection.
controllers_and_reference: Core heating comes only from coupled point kinetics: a fixed axial power shape is multiplied by fixed MPACT radial weights across all 148 explicit fuel channels and normalized to 10 MW total in steady state. No prescribed Core Heat Source is attached, avoiding additive heating. Transient power follows the PK amplitude. This 10 MW comparison case exceeds the cited PSAR 1 MW reference power.
Pump Momentum 39662.81 Pa is inherited from primary_loop.json. It is a prescribed pressure rise, not volumetric forcing, a pump curve, or a PSAR-calibrated flow rate.

HX Wall Function fixes the effective shell-side wall temperature at 832 K, inherited from primary_loop.json. The solver supplies its heat-transfer correlation. Heat removal depends on the solution; 1 MW is not prescribed as heat flux.

PressureReferenceBC surface 0 selects the cell on the toNode side of mesh surface 0 using the existing syTH convention. With the current mesh this is in the lower plenum. Reference pressure is 150000 Pa absolute, based on the Chapter 4 vessel baseline; this is not the RAV cover-gas pressure.

FLiBe is the supported fluid selector inherited from primary_loop.json and maps to the built-in FLiBe_UF4 property model. Those properties approximate the PSAR 67LiF-28BeF2-5UF4 fuel salt; exact composition-dependent properties are not supplied.
omissions: No RAV, tank components, cover gas, drain branches, secondary loop, radiator, graphite or steel heat capacity, spatial neutronics, point kinetics, decay heat, or pump-coastdown transient.
model_notes.limits: This input is a thermal-hydraulic surrogate. The PSAR 923.15 K maximum temperature is documented, not enforced by a controller. Assumed geometry, pump head, HX area and wall temperature require calibration for quantitative PSAR reproduction.
model_notes.execution: Use the Python frontend to export HDF5, then the C++ syTH solver: python3 -m syth.syTH PSAR.json --h5write; syTH.exe PSAR.h5 PSAR-results.h5. PressureReferenceBC is not implemented in the installed pure-Python solver.

Fuel Channel.comment: Single explicit fuel channel: 3.016 cm diameter, 1.5168 m active height, 16 axial cells (Table 4.2-1).

Core.comment: 148 explicit parallel fuel channels in a simplified hexagonal lattice. Required internal plenums are negligible-length connectors; finite Lower Plenum and Upper Plenum components remain in the loop. The three zero entries are omitted lattice sites, not resolved control-rod thimbles.
